source: Original prompts written for this app, in the spirit of Brian Eno and Peter Schmidt's Oblique Strategies cards. Put your own deck, one card per line, in data/oblique_strategies.txt to use it instead.
prompts: What would you keep if you could keep only one part?
Make it worse on purpose, then look again
Remove the thing you are proudest of
What would a child do here?
Take a walk and come back
Do it twice as fast and badly
Use only what is in reach
Put it away for a day
Copy something you admire, then break it
What is the obvious answer? Try it
Repeat it until it becomes something else
Turn the problem into a list
Look at it in a mirror
Name the mistake and keep it
What would you do with no audience?
Go back to the first idea
Ask what it needs, not what you want
Work in silence for ten minutes
Look at it from across the room
Where is the energy? Go there
Make a version for someone you love
What would happen if it were quieter?
Imagine it is already done. What changed?
